title: Female Cyberpunk Spellcaster
description: Four sequential poses of the same short-haired woman in a futuristic armored outfit performing a magical attack. Glowing orange and blue energy effects swirl around her hands and form an orb above her head as she progresses through casting motions against a dark background.
prompt: A female character with short white hair wearing black tactical gear, brown leather straps, knee pads and boots, shown in four sequential action poses casting a spell. She manipulates glowing orange and blue magical energy that forms swirling rings and a bright orb between her hands. Dynamic combat stances against a solid dark gray background, sci-fi fantasy aesthetic, highly detailed digital artwork.
